title.narrative: ROAF/KEN/Partnership Implementing the New Urban Agenda (PINUA)

description.narrative:
The overall objective of this action is Upscaling of adequate housing and communities’ green co-production. PINUA-1 is to offer paths towards inclusive community development, housing finance, and sustainable housing construction catalysing not only private sector investments but moreover community and households’ investments. PINUA Phase 2, will involve financing from the EIB and will be bringing these streams of supply at scale Component 1: Serves as a mechanism to unlock more efficient supply vehicles (PINUA 1).
Component 1: service as a mechanism to unlock more efficient supply vehicles (PINUA1) This component is designed to bridge the investment gap through three different funding streams. PINUA's central premise to addressing this gap is the notion of ‘co-production’, a term loosely defined as individual or collective contributions to the production and provision of public services or social goods such as housing. Co-production implies a focus on the delivery of services, the notions of co-management, and (even more so) co-construction, suggesting citizens’ proactive participation in planning, design, and implementation, as well as the mobilisation of their own resources to contribute towards implementation of policies and of community development. Stream One is co-production of green incremental housing, stream two is participatory slum upgrading and stream three is cooperative social rental housing.
In PINUA 1: Unlocking three different supply streams, the action proposes to work in the unlocking of three supply streams with the potential of growing at scale. This will include 1) Owner-driven/household-led incremental and green low-cost housing; 2) Participatory Slum Upgrading; 3) Cooperative-led social rental housing.
Component 2: With the support of the EU, the UNH act in a conveying role to facilitate DFIs, provide technical assistance, grant management, implementation support (PINUA 2). This component will focus on accompanying the implementation of the financing taking the proofs of concept to scale
